propositions: Rebar's LLM runtime is Anthropic-shaped in practice despite claiming provider-agnosticism, with hardcoded checks for Anthropic provider strings and no native Bedrock support path
AWS Bedrock must be a first-class provider with full capability parity including prompt caching, native structured output, and proper retry/timeout semantics via botocore configuration
Provider selection and capability detection must delegate to pydantic-ai's native ModelProfile and provider_factory hooks rather than matching provider name strings
OpenAI-compatible endpoints reachable through REBAR_LLM_BASE_URL + REBAR_LLM_API_KEY composition must work as documented and route through a best-effort provider tier
Signed verdict sidecars must carry structured provider_provenance including provider name, model identifier, endpoint host, support tier classification, and effective capability flags

Retry policy (llm_retry_max_attempts, llm_retry_max_wait_s) and read timeout (timeout_s) configuration must not reach Bedrock under the current implementation and require botocore.config.Config threaded via bedrock_client parameter
